latest.headline: scagliox01 Claims Estonia Victory with Tactical Consistency
latest.paragraph: In a competitive JWRC outing at the Estonia rally, scagliox01 secured victory with a total time of 00:36:35.839, earning 39 points. Despite SubaruNyx securing four stage wins, penalty-induced time losses relegated them to third on the final podium. Flinnowaty maintained a steady pace to claim second place, finishing 18.353 seconds behind the leader. Cefa217 managed to win the Power Stage despite an earlier DNF, adding 5 points to their tally. The event saw four drivers record DNF results across the eight stages, highlighting the technical challenges faced by all competitors.
